CALL apoc.periodic.iterate(
 "
 MATCH (t:Transaction)
 WHERE t.method_id IN ['deposit', 'withdraw']
 RETURN t
 ORDER BY t.timestamp ASC
 ",
 "
 WITH t
 OPTIONAL MATCH (prevTx:Transaction)
 WHERE prevTx.timestamp < t.timestamp
 AND prevTx.method_id IN ['deposit', 'withdraw']
 WITH t, prevTx
 ORDER BY prevTx.timestamp DESC
 LIMIT 1
 WITH
 t,
 prevTx,
 CASE
 WHEN prevTx IS NULL AND t.method_id = 'deposit' THEN 1
 WHEN prevTx IS NULL AND t.method_id = 'withdraw' THEN 0
 WHEN t.method_id = 'deposit' THEN coalesce(prevTx.open_count, 0) 
+ 1
 WHEN t.method_id = 'withdraw' THEN
 CASE
 WHEN coalesce(prevTx.open_count, 0) > 0 THEN 
prevTx.open_count - 1
 ELSE 0
 END
 END AS newOpenCount
 SET
 t.open_count = newOpenCount,
 t.anonymity_set =
 CASE
 WHEN t.method_id = 'deposit' THEN 
coalesce(prevTx.anonymity_set, 0) + 1
 WHEN t.method_id = 'withdraw' THEN
 CASE
 WHEN newOpenCount = 0 THEN 0
 ELSE coalesce(prevTx.anonymity_set, 0)
 END
 END
 ",
 {batchSize: 1, parallel: false}
)

MATCH (w:Transaction)-[:TO]->(c:Contract)
WHERE w.method_id = 'withdraw'
OPTIONAL MATCH (prevReset:Transaction)-[:TO]->(c)
WHERE prevReset.timestamp < w.timestamp
AND prevReset.anonymity_set = 0 
WITH w, c, prevReset
ORDER BY prevReset.timestamp 
DESC WITH w, c, collect(prevReset)[0] AS lastReset
MATCH (d:Transaction)-[:TO]->(c)
WHERE d.method_id = 'deposit'
AND d.timestamp > coalesce(lastReset.timestamp, 0)
AND d.timestamp <= w.timestamp 
MERGE (w)-[:POSSIBLE_DEPOSIT]->(d);

MATCH (w:Transaction)
WHERE w.method_id = 'withdraw'
OPTIONAL MATCH (w)-[:POSSIBLE_DEPOSIT]->(d:Transaction)
WITH w, count(d) AS cnt
SET w.possible_deposit_count = cnt;

MATCH (w:Transaction)
WHERE w.method_id = 'withdraw'
AND w.possible_deposit_count = 1
MATCH (w)-[r:POSSIBLE_DEPOSIT]->(d:Transaction)
RETURN w, r, d;

MATCH (t:Transaction )-[:TO]-(:Contract)
RETURN t.method_id AS method, t.gas_price AS gasPrice, COUNT(*) AS entriesCount
ORDER BY method, gasPrice

AND NONE(node IN nodes(p) WHERE node:Contract)
